Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Mia. She was very brave and always scared. One day, Mia was walking in the woods when she saw a little scared little bunny. She was scared, but she wanted to help the bunny.

Mia went to her mom and said, "Mom, can you help me borrow my flashlight?" Her mom smiled and said, "Yes, Mia. I will give it to you."

Mia was so happy and said, "Thank you, Mommy. I love you, Mommy."

Mia was so happy and hugged her mom. She hugged her mom and said, "I love you, Mommy. I love you too, Mommy."

The bunny was so happy and thanked Mia for her help. Mia's mom smiled and said, "You're welcome, Mia. I'm glad you like it."

Once upon a time there was a brave little girl named Mia. She loved to play with her lantern. One day, she was playing in the garden when she saw a bright light. She wanted to touch it, but it was too high.

Mia's brother, Jack, saw her and said, "Mia, don't be scared! I have a lantern. I have a lantern that can help people see. I will give it to you."

Mia was scared, but she trusted Jack. She held the lantern up high and showed it to him. Jack was so happy and he said, "Thank you, Mia! You are so brave!"

Mia smiled and said, "You're welcome, Jack. I'm glad I could help. Now, let's go play with my lantern!"

Mia and Jack went to play in the garden, and Mia was so happy. She learned that it's important to share with others, and it's always good to be brave.

Once upon a time there was a brave little girl named Mia. She was only three years old and she loved to play with her friends. One day, Mia was playing in her backyard when she saw a lantern. She was so excited and wanted to keep it for herself.

Mia's brother, Tom, saw her holding the lantern and said, "Mia, why don't you share it with your friends? That way, everyone can be happy."

Mia thought about it for a moment and then said, "Okay, I will share it with you."

So Mia and Tom went to the park and shared the lantern. They had so much fun playing together that they didn't even notice the dark clouds in the sky.

Suddenly, Mia heard a voice. It was her brother, who said, "Mia, I'm so scared. I don't want to share my lantern with anyone."

Mia was so scared that she ran away. She held the lantern up high so everyone could see.

Tom was so sad that he had been scared too. He said, "Mia, I'm sorry. I didn't mean to scare you. I'm sorry I scared you."

Mia smiled and said, "It's okay. I'm glad you're not scared anymore."

Tom and Mia hugged each other and went back to playing in the backyard. They were happy that they had shared the special lantern and that they were safe.

Once upon a time, there was a brave little girl named Mia. She was afraid of the dark and always wanted to stay safe. One night, Mia was walking in the woods and saw a lantern. She was so excited and wanted to take it home. She held the lantern up high so everyone could see.

Suddenly, she heard a voice. It was her little brother, Jack. He said, "Mia, why are you so scared of the dark?" Mia replied, "I'm scared of the dark. I don't want to go home."

Jack smiled and said, "Don't worry, Mia. I have an extra lantern. You can share it with me. We can share it together." Mia was so happy and felt brave again.

The next day, Mia and Jack went to the woods together. They saw a little cottage and Mia said, "Let's share the lantern and take it home." Jack agreed and they both took the lantern home.

Mia learned a lesson that day. She learned that it is important to share and be brave, even when you are scared.
